subject: MAP starter: compact evaluation playbook + GDoc draft
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@orientdata.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP starter: compact evaluation playbook + GDoc draft

Hi Caroline —

Thanks for the time on Friday. As discussed, I pulled together a compact MAP that lines up the key decision milestones, owners, and the tech validation steps we agreed on. I attached a lightweight GDoc draft ("MAP_playbook_compact_v1.gdoc_stub") and a brief slide deck to use in the demo.

Key items in the draft: 
- 30-day acceptance criteria (tech + business)
- Week-by-week validation checklist (infra, latency, sample prompts)
- Stakeholder owners and suggested meeting cadence
- Quick rollback/fallback plan and SLO targets to validate with your infra team

Next steps I suggest: 
1) You plus Sam iterate on the acceptance criteria inline in the GDoc.
2) If okay, we calendar a 45-minute kickoff next week to align owners and demo scope.
3) Ben will scope a short test plan for a 2-node Dedicated trial and share cost estimates.

Links/attachments are at the bottom of the email. Let me know preferred times for the kickoff; I have open windows Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: MAP_playbook_compact_v1.gdoc_stub (Google Doc), demo_slide_deck_v1.pptx_stub (PowerPoint)

From: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@orientdata.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orientdata.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP starter: compact evaluation playbook + GDoc draft

Aditya —

Appreciate the tidy draft. Quick notes from me after a short pass: 
- Acceptance criteria: can we add an objective for 99th percentile inference latency under our trial load (currently ~150ms target)? I added a short comment in the GDoc.
- Week 1 infra checklist: include a step for network egress profiling — our security team will want that documented.
- Demo scope: Sam and I prefer a 30-minute focused demo (model-to-inference path + tracking) followed by a 30-minute tech Q&A for our infra/security folks.

I'll put inline comments in the GDoc tonight and Sam will follow up tomorrow with availability for the kickoff.

Thanks —
Caroline
Director, ML Engineering | OrientData
caroline.wu@orientdata.ai

Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP starter: compact evaluation playbook + GDoc draft

Caroline —

Thanks for the quick pass and the comments — I see the latency note and the egress item. We'll incorporate both. A few clarifications from our side: 
- The 150ms baseline you mentioned — is that under a per-request 1–2 concurrent stream load or under the anticipated production-like burst profile? Ben will size the Dedicated trial nodes once we confirm load assumptions.
- For the demo timing, good call on split sessions. We'll prepare the 30-minute demo + 30-minute tech Q&A schedule.

Action items on our side: 
- Marissa will fold your inline comments into the GDoc and add the network egress checklist.
- Ben will draft the 2-node Dedicated trial cost estimate and perf assumptions by EOD Tuesday.
- I'll propose two kickoff windows (Tue 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 11:00–12:00 PT).

If anything else from Sam or the security team comes up, ping me directly.

Best,
Aditya

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@orientdata.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@orientdata.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP starter: compact evaluation playbook + GDoc draft

Quick note — I pushed a short perf-cost appendix into the GDoc (section: "Trial sizing & cost assumptions"). High level: a 2-node Dedicated pool (A100-style) should cover a realistic 30d eval at the sample throughput we discussed; I'll attach a simple cost table in the doc.

Also flagged a short test for KV-cache warmup times (small script) — will include steps and expected signals for pass/fail in the Week 1 checklist.

If you want, I can join the kickoff to run the demo perf section.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
